scope: Internal style, clarity, and evidential-scope audit; not external peer review.

request_resolution.request: Figure 1 aligned markers without connectors or numeric annotations
request_resolution.resolution: Both scatters use identical y coordinates; connector drawing and point annotations removed. The x axis gives OpenAI-minus-Mathlib percentage-point estimates. Separate full and shared-domain estimates are explained in the caption. Underlying rates and differences are retained.

request_resolution.request: Academic captions and clearer code presentation
request_resolution.resolution: Bold numbered labels, normal roman caption text, consistent spacing and punctuation; lighter top/bottom listing rules, source captions, upright apostrophes, and a reserved page block for the seven-line Crouzeix excerpt. Vector PDF embedded for Figure 1.

Safe(O,S,e,x) is typeset as a mathematical operator with arguments defined. Other bare predicate applications, CanConv, optional seam identifiers, residual notation, graph-affine coefficients, dimension restrictions, normalized circle measure, conjugation and matrix norm conventions are explained. The period-one Fourier phase is aligned with the retained TaylorFourier/FaberCalculus source convention.

request_resolution.request: Clarify worked examples and survey statements
request_resolution.resolution: The mean example identifies probability laws and multiplicity vectors separately; the closed-ideal example is described as norm-closed; sampling probabilities and interval levels are labeled. The original Lean examples and literal upstream proof excerpts are unchanged.

request_resolution.request: AI versus human practice and possible differential speed
request_resolution.resolution: Added a restrained workflow hypothesis based on the availability of proved interfaces and tactic-compatible local obligations, explicitly allowing within-field variation and counting interface construction cost. No causal speed, cognitive, or superiority conclusion is drawn from the source corpora. Proposed matched-task outcomes include unsuccessful attempts, time, intervention, costs, reuse, and blinded clarity judgments.

Cites primary ProofOptimizer and Lean Refactor preprints for Lean-checked replacement and separate length/checking-cost objectives. Their results are not claimed to shorten these six cases. Kintali is excluded from the bibliography and supporting evidence because correctness has not been assessed; the deferral is recorded in research/style-review/references.json.

request_resolution.request: Versioned GitHub reproduction citation and complete data
request_resolution.resolution: Data and code availability and reference GounderArchitectureData2026 identify reproduction edition v1.6.0. The package includes the previously local deep-case evidence, all 800 sampled source modules, joint comparison data, scripts, source hashes and verification records.
